question: What is the maximum award amount under the SCF Build Award, and in what currency is it paid?

golden.answer: An SCF Build Award is up to $150,000 worth of XLM (as of 2026-11-14), paid in milestone-based tranches: 10% on acceptance, then 20%, 30% and 40% on three deliverables. The USD value is converted to XLM when each payment is scheduled.
keyFacts: The SCF Build Award cap is $150,000 worth of XLM.
Funding is paid in milestone-based tranches, not up front.
The split is 10% on acceptance, then 20%, 30% and 40% on three deliverables.
avoid: Do NOT say Build is paid in fixed USD or USDC by default.
Do NOT call acceptance a fourth deliverable milestone.
golden.notes: $300K is a lifecycle total in the v7 blog, not the single Build award.

corroboration.claim: A current Build Award is capped at $150K USD-equivalent and paid in XLM using the scheduled-payment valuation
